description: Get Soclo’s authoritative price for filming a ready storyboard. FREE — quoting spends nothing. ALWAYS quote before soclo_video_make, and pass the quoted figures back unchanged: Soclo refuses to film if the real price has moved past them, which is your protection against paying more than the quote. Requires the projectId and revision from a soclo_plan read whose phase is "ready". Returns quoteId, revision, the credit price, whether filming is connected, and the exact per-take speech fit report. Show the owner the price and report; only film when speechFit.makeReady is true and the owner approves. A quote can exist while speech needs changes or is unmeasured. Preserve the authored lines; do not rewrite them automatically.

revision.description: From the ready project in soclo_plan.

speechFitMode.description: Optional free probe using only existing measured speech; omitted quotes measure speech normally. Adds no synthesis permission step.
